    """Extract a Python script-appropriate header string from the IR.

    For Python-origin notebooks, ``ir.header.value`` already holds the raw
    header text (which may contain a PEP 723 ``# /// script`` block and

    if ir.header is None:
        return ""

    value = ir.header.value
    if not value:
        return ""

    # Python comment headers parse to ``None`` under YAML, so a dict result
    # unambiguously identifies frontmatter.
    import yaml

    try:
        frontmatter = yaml.safe_load(value)

            get_headers_from_frontmatter,
        )

        headers = get_headers_from_frontmatter(frontmatter)
        return headers["pyproject"] or headers["header"]
